name: PTSD Family Coach
one_liner: PTSD Family Coach is a free app from the VA for partners and family members of someone living with PTSD.
best_for: Partners and family of someone with PTSD
Looking after yourself as a supporter
not_for: Anyone in crisis (call or text 988, then press 1 for the Veterans Crisis Line)
short_description: PTSD Family Coach is a free app from the VA for partners and family members of someone living with PTSD.
long_description: PTSD Family Coach is a free app from the VA for partners and family members of someone living with PTSD. Information about PTSD, help encouraging a loved one into treatment, and 24 tools for managing your own stress, with progress tracking. Made by the VA's National Center for PTSD with the Department of Defense. What it includes: PTSD education for families; 24 stress-management tools; Stress tracking; Help encouraging treatment.

faqs.q: How much does PTSD Family Coach cost?
faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with PTSD Family Coach before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can PTSD Family Coach replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. PTSD Family Coach is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use PTSD Family Coach?
faqs.a: PTSD Family Coach is available on iPhone and Android.

faqs.q: What does PTSD Family Coach include?
faqs.a: PTSD education for families; 24 stress-management tools; Stress tracking; Help encouraging treatment.
